about.title: Why I made this
about.body: I spend a lot of time walking through Ueno Park, and I’m always running into birds I don’t recognize. I kept wondering what these little neighbors were called, so I put together this guide to help put names to faces. The layout and visual idea are inspired by AvianVisitors (theodore.net).

data.title: Where the sightings come from
data.body: The species list and seasonal frequencies are compiled from community sightings on eBird. Birds that visit more often in a given season appear larger on the home page, and every entry in the Atlas links to its official eBird page if you want to dig deeper.

art.title: Illustrations
art.body: Each bird is illustrated in the style of traditional Japanese kachō-e (bird-and-flower prints). The artwork is generated with AI from real reference photos of each species, then checked by hand for accuracy.

Audio.title: Audio credits
Audio.body: All bird calls on this site come directly from xeno-canto, shared unmodified from the original recordings. Below you’ll find the recordist, catalog number, source link, and Creative Commons license for each track.
